facts.fact: Titanic struck an iceberg that buckled the steel plates and opened six compartments to the sea.
Passengers felt a bump or shudder, some mistaking it for the ship shedding a propeller blade.
Water poured into the ship at 7 long tons per second, faster than it could be pumped out.
Titanic had 20 lifeboats for 1,178 people, barely a third of the total capacity.
Most people in -2 °C water died in 15–30 minutes from cold shock and hypothermia.

sentences.text: You’d feel a sudden jolt as the iceberg struck the hull, just as though you were driving over a thousand marbles.
Water flooded lower decks rapidly, flooding compartments at 7 tons per second.

title: What If You Were on the Sinking Titanic?
